newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee ends low in kerb, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee ends low in kerb, seen falling.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended 0.02 lower in the kerb market at 40.37 to the dollar on Sunday as dollar demand rose slightly on fear of a central bank depreciation, dealers said.
"The rupee is likely to fall on the fear of lower adjustment," one dealer said.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan has given no indication that a depreciation is due, but has not changed its official rate of 36.9700/37.1549 to the dollar since September 10.
The premium on the foreign exchange bearer certificates closed unchanged at 8.60 percent. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
